svg.title: Тяга горизонтального блока широкой рукоятью — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wide-handle seated low cable row, 45-degree side-front camera that clearly shows the width of both hands. One intact horizontal straight wide row bar held overhand, with hands farther apart than shoulders. A single horizontal cable visibly connects the center of that wide bar to the low pulley in front. Athlete sits on low bench, feet on foot plates, knees soft and spine upright. Left: both arms extended toward pulley. Right: bar pulled toward lower chest with elbows bent and clearly flared outward. Same machine, same wide bar, same low cable and foot support in both panels. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
